Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: locally_qualified_not_landed.
Assessment: Exactc69a5d75 default Git-pin build, CLI/notices/offline/TZ and explicit Atlas override are reviewed local evidence.
Staleness: Review is current; old instructions to redo fresh S1 preparation are obsolete.
Remaining / next action: Carry c69a5d75 as an ancestor of the single integration range. Requalify the actual packaged integration bytes and distinguish source/CLI from Maven publication.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Outcome: a new developer can build from the declared GitHub sources, and a researcher can run the extracted CLI without sbt or unpublished Maven artifacts.

Owner decision: grakern stays pinned to GitHub for now. Preserve the current immutable revision 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841 unless a separately reviewed change is necessary. Its existing graph4s/Gale source pins are part of the recipe. Do not switch to grakern publication candidate 539a9e16: that branch expects the unpublished fixed JVM binaries. Floating branches and local overrides cannot prove this route.

Paths: build.sbt grakernRevision/grakernBuild; project/CliDistribution.scala; tools/release; docs/release-preparation.md; README.md; mapping guide and current release indices.

Acceptance:
1. A clean standalone checkout resolves the exact grakern and transitive Git commits using fresh isolated sbt/Coursier staging and no source override, local Maven repository or pre-existing checkout. Record fetch URLs, SHAs, required access and JDK/toolchain identities. Missing/wrong revision or override contamination must fail the verification.
2. Run the affected producer gate and build sbt 'pipeline/cliDistribution'. Extract to a fresh directory, verify every manifest entry and runtime dependency, then run the public paired exchange, weights 0/1,1/2,1/1 and independent readers outside the source checkout. Replay after denying network access must pass with recorded local inputs; distinguish build-time network requirements from offline execution.
3. Source/CLI installation has one documented reproducible recipe and a receipt bound to the packaged bytes. The final artifact includes dependency provenance and applicable license notices.
4. Compute the actual Maven dependency closure and name which artifacts remain unpublishable while grakern is source-pinned. Preserve failing public-resolution evidence and the future publication path. Do not replace missing coordinates with GitHub URLs in POMs, silently drop dependencies, call local staging public, or claim the full 56-artifact matrix is published.
5. Existing docs deployment and stable-construction repairs stay completed. Central account/signing work and upstream Maven publication are deferred from this immediate source/CLI milestone, not declared successful. Reconcile the relevant release instructions accordingly.

Next action: inspect the current source-pin recipe and design its fresh-environment witness; reuse the already qualified runtime rather than upgrading dependencies speculatively.
Stop condition: an inaccessible pinned source or reproducibility failure blocks S1; retain the failing command and repair the narrow cause. A changed distribution promise or dependency fork requires a recorded owner decision.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
